summary: Omit absent optional fields in relayed conversation frames

replay.detail: No claim replay or stored message changes.

schema.detail: The published client-v0 schema remains unchanged. Generated Rust models omit absent non-nullable optional fields instead of serializing them as null.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated upgrade required.

compatibility.detail: Relayed conversation snapshots and changes conform to the existing collection schema. Present field values are unchanged, and fields explicitly permitting null retain their existing serialization, including message reply_to, pagination cursors and nullable resource fields.

downtime.detail: No additional startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No configuration changes or operator actions required.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
